title: Book Two · Chapter 72: Mum's New Price
story:
On Wednesday evening, Mum has a jacket on the table. Its owner wants new buttons and a change to the sleeves. Ronan likes the dark cloth. He strokes it once. Mum asks him to move his hands.

“This belongs to someone else.”

“Is it ready soon?”

“I have not agreed to the whole job.”

Mum turns a sleeve inside out. The cloth at the edge is thin. She shows Dad. Then she writes a short note beside her first price.

“What is wrong?” Ronan asks.

“It needs more work here. I could change only the buttons for the first price. The sleeves cost more.”

“Will the customer be angry?”

“She may say no.”

Ronan watches Mum put the jacket back in its clean bag. He wants her to finish it quickly and earn the money. She may lose this job before she begins. He does not like that thought.

The customer comes the next afternoon. Ronan is doing his school work at the far end of the table. Mum lays out the jacket and opens the sleeve edge.

She explains the extra work. Then she gives two prices. One is for buttons only. The other includes the sleeves.

The woman looks at the jacket for a long time. She holds one cuff against her wrist. Mum keeps her pencil on the paper. She waits.

“Buttons only for now,” the woman says. “I can keep the sleeves this way.”

Mum writes a new price. The customer agrees to it. They choose the collection day together.

After she leaves, Ronan looks at the crossed note.

“Less money,” he says.

“Less work too,” Mum says. “That leaves time for another small job.”

“Do you have one?”

“Yes. And I have an evening for myself tomorrow.”

She puts the jacket on the work chair. Ronan moves his book away. Mum will need the rest of the table.

Later, Mum shows him a button with a broken back. It looks whole from the front. He turns it over in his fingers.

“Can I keep it?”

“Ask the owner when she collects the jacket. It is still hers.”

Ronan leaves it beside the bag. When the woman returns, he asks. She lets him have the broken button. Mum gives the finished jacket to her and checks the payment.

That evening, Ronan draws the button in his birthday book. He makes a front view and a back view. “A tiny chair?” Dad says at the second picture. Ronan adds an arrow and writes button underneath.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

price＝价格；sleeve＝袖子；button＝钮扣。

## 理解问题

1. Mum为什么调整这次报价？
2. 顾客怎样作出自己的选择？

## 读句子

**Mum / writes / a new price.** Mum／写下／一个新价格。
